title: Nintendo (news release, 11 Nov 2026): The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2, a full remake of the 1998 N64 game launched 5 Nov 2026, sold over 5.2 million units worldwide in its first four days, including 8,10,000 in Japan (physical + digital); Nintendo says it is the highest first-four-days global sales for any Nintendo-published Switch 2 game. For scale (Nintendo IR, as of 30 Sep 2026): Donkey Kong Bananza 5.05 million life-to-date, Mario Kart World 16.48 million
